# DeepL

> DeepL is an AI-powered language platform offering enterprise-grade translation, voice, writing assistance, and agentic workflow automation with industry-leading security and compliance.

DeepL provides a comprehensive suite of AI language tools designed for global enterprises, including secure translation, real-time voice translation, intelligent writing assistance, and autonomous agents for workflow automation. The platform emphasizes data privacy, compliance (GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA), and seamless integration with popular enterprise tools like Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
